about_section_title: Temporary Placement Center for Persons with Disabilities (Adults) from Bălți municipality
about_text_1:
The Temporary Placement Center for Persons with Disabilities (Adults) from Bălți municipality is a public institution managed by the Agency for Management of Highly Specialized Services, within the Ministry of Labor and Social Protection of the Republic of Moldova. The institution was founded in 1981 as "Veterans of Labor and War Home". In 1984 the institution was repurposed as "Psychoneurological Boarding School" and later renamed as Temporary Placement Center for Persons with Disabilities (Adults) from Bălți municipality (2018).
The Center has residential blocks, polyclinic, administrative block, food block, dining room, church, warehouses, library, festive hall, laundry, autonomous thermal power plant and other auxiliary rooms.
about_text_2: The Mission of the Center consists in providing assistance and complex interventions that may include any combination of specialized social services, provided to beneficiaries with increased dependency (persons with intellectual and psychosocial disabilities) and who require continuous supervision (24/24 hours) to improve quality of life.
about_text_3: Beneficiaries of the Center are persons with disabilities, citizens of the Republic of Moldova or foreigners, specified in art.2, para. (1) of Law no. 274/2011 on the integration of foreigners in the Republic of Moldova.

faq_what_is_CPTPD_q: What is the Temporary Placement Center for Persons with Disabilities (Adults)?
faq_what_is_CPTPD_a: The Temporary Placement Center for Persons with Disabilities (Adults) from Bălți municipality is a public social assistance institution that offers specialized services for young children (0-7 years) at risk or with special needs. The center operates under the Agency for Social Services and Inclusion and has the mission of protecting, caring for and rehabilitating vulnerable children.
faq_what_services_q: What services does the center offer?
faq_what_services_a: The center offers multiple specialized services: Crisis and Family Reintegration Section for children in emergency situations, Maternal Section for mothers and children in difficulty, Day Section for children with neuro-motor disabilities, Respite Section for families with special needs children, Psycho-pedagogical Assistance Section, Rehabilitation Section and Medical Assistance Section.
faq_how_to_apply_q: How can I request the center's services?
faq_how_to_apply_a: To request the center's services, you must contact the Child Protection Directorate from Bălți municipality or the local guardianship and trusteeship authorities. They will evaluate the situation and issue, if necessary, a placement order. You can also contact the center directly at 022 737 027 for consultations.
faq_emergency_contact_q: What number can I call in case of emergency?
faq_emergency_contact_a: In case of emergency, you can call 022 737 027, which operates 24/7. The center has a non-stop operating regime for crisis situations. You can also contact the Emergency Child Protection Service or competent local authorities.
